title.narrative: ECO-SOLVE: disrupting illicit environmental commodity flows through innovative activities.

description.narrative: Contract related to: ECO-SOLVE: disrupting illicit environmental commodity flows through innovative activities. - The overall objective of the action is the increased effectiveness of efforts to combat organised crime, illicit trafficking in all its forms, smuggling and disrupting criminal networks along main trafficking routes. This objective will be pursued mainly through the Global Illicit Flows Programme, an umbrella programme under which the support to combating environmental crime, trafficking by sea, and SALW proliferation will be delivered.

title.narrative: Increased effectiveness of efforts to combat illicit trafficking, smuggling and organized crime.

description.narrative: An interim target will be an assessment by an external expert about whether these scores have risen or fallen, organized by the Global Organized Crime Index team in July 2026.A final target will be reduction in the criminal market score for flora and fauna crimes from 2026 onwards (reflected in the 2027 Global Organized Crime Index) that are not due to changed methodology for the 35 countries defined in the prioritization exercise.

title.narrative: Organised Crime Index

description.narrative: The Organized Crime Index ENACT (ocindex.net)https://dataunodc.un.org/

comment.narrative: The baseline indicator for the impact draws on the 2023 Global Organized Crime Index looking at countries flora and fauna criminal market scores for 35 countries defined in the prioritization exercise.

An interim target will be an assessment by an external expert about whether these scores have risen or fallen organized by the Global Organized Crime Index team in July 2026.A final target will be reduction in the criminal market score for flora and fauna crimes from 2026 onwards reflected in the 2027 Global Organized Crime Index that are not due to changed methodology for the 35 countries defined in the prioritization exercise.
